Hoffman Defends AI Data Center Boom

On Friday, Hoffman made the remarks during an appearance on the ‘Newcomer’ podcast released Friday, saying the huge amount of capital behind the AI infrastructure buildout was "the only reason we’re not in a recession."
He said "most of that capital" does not go directly to areas where data centers are being built but is "more distributed across the country."
He also highlighted the broader economic impact of data center construction, saying it provides work for construction workers, carpenters, real estate agents, electricians and lawyers.

"All of this capital infusion, people think, ‘Oh, that’s just going to the tech companies,’" LinkedIn cofounder said, adding that a "massive percentage of it is going towards data center construction."
Hoffman also said data center developers should work fairly with local communities to ensure both sides benefit.
